messages:
maya: Heads-up — I posted a draft release note for the runtime tweak we're rolling this week. Need ops + legal quick-eyes. Plan is to pin the EU canary to runtime:v1.12 to avoid kernel mismatch with recent model builds. PTAL below.

maya: Draft RN snippet:
```
Runtime update: runtime:v1.12 — improved attention kernel selection for long-context workloads.
Canary: EU region, pinned to runtime:v1.12 for 6h.
Rollback criteria: service error rate >0.5% sustained for 5m OR latency p95 increase >20% over baseline.
No DB schema or customer-facing API changes.
```

deploy-bot: /deploy canary runtime:v1.12 region=eu start=2026-03-25T22:00Z — queued. Preview: https://deploys.redwood.internal/ops/1745012345

joel: Which metric source should SRE watch for that 0.5%? envoy 5xx or app-level traces? :eyes:

sre-oncall: Use envoy 5xx for immediate surface and app traces for root cause. Also watch token-generation latency (token_latency.p95).

caroline: Copy nit — "pinned to runtime:v1.12" reads fine, but suggest "pin runtime image to v1.12 for EU canary" to avoid ambiguity about model vs runtime.

ben: Quick Q: do we need to pin model versions as well, or just runtime?

maya: Just runtime for this rollout. Models are unaffected. I'll add clarifying language to RN.

legal-bot: Legal check: no change to data handling or retention. OK to proceed (auto-ack).

maya: If SRE triggers rollback, use the following snippet to revert to v1.11:
```bash
# rollback to previous runtime image
kubectl -n infra set image deploy/runtime-service runtime=image:redwood/runtime:v1.11
# OR if using rollout history
kubectl -n infra rollout undo deployment/runtime-service --to-revision=<revision-number>
```

sre-oncall: :thumbsup: I'll own the monitoring and will post a short status every 5m during the 6h canary. I'll also create an emergency flag channel if we need immediate attention.

ben: Small add: add "No DB schema changes" to the top-level RN bullet so folks scanning quickly see it.

maya: Done — final RN uploaded here: https://docs.redwood.internal/rn/2026-03-runtime-v1.12. Scheduling deploy for 22:00Z. Thanks all — I'll ping when it starts.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 2026-03-25T22:00:05Z — runtime:v1.12 deployed to eu-canary. Live monitor: https://metrics.redwood.internal/dashboards/runtime-canary-1745012345

sre-oncall: Initial warmup looks stable (p95 within baseline). Will update in 15. :party_parrot:
